description: Na₃TiF₈ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmcm space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.74 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent TiF₆ octahedra and edges with two equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-56°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.15-2.38 Å. Ti is bonded to six F atoms to form TiF₆ octahedra that share corners with eight equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-56°. There are a spread of Ti-F bond distances ranging from 1.85-1.89 Å. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two Na and one Ti atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Ti atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Ti atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Na atoms.
